title: Terms for Cancelling a Borrower-Elected Set-Aside
content:
A set-aside held under Set-Aside Accounts may be cancelled by the borrower only where the plan permits borrower cancellation by signed request — the Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected) and the Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve. A request to cancel any other plan, including a mandatory LESA imposed by the financial assessment, is declined as cancellation not permitted. Only the borrower can cancel; the servicer records the borrower's own signed request.

## Conditions

1. **Signed request on file.** A cancellation takes effect only against a borrower-elected cancellation request on file for that set-aside whose request status is received and which every borrower on the loan signed.
2. **Waiting period.** A cancellation is accepted only on or after the date the plan's minimum number of calendar months after the set-aside was established.
   - Clock start: the set-aside's established date, as its record shows.
   - Counting: that date is the same day number in the month that many calendar months after the established date, falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist.
   - Equality: the date itself qualifies.
   - Unmet: an earlier request is declined as too early.
3. **No open repayment plan.** A cancellation is refused while the loan has a property charge repayment plan (Property Charge Advance Repayment) whose status is pending signature, active or defaulted, and such a request is declined as a corporate advance outstanding, as the plan's setting requires.

## Effect

On cancellation the whole remaining balance is released on the same date, with the reason "borrower-elected cancellation", to the plan's release destination: the HECM available line for a borrower-elected LESA, a reduction of the Summit loan balance for the Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve. From then on every property charge is the borrower's to pay.

## Boundary cases on hypothetical dates

| Plan and established date | Earliest acceptance date | Request on the day before | Request on that date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected), 12 months, established 10 June 2026 | 10 June 2027 | Too early | Accepted (other conditions met) |
| Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected), 12 months, established 29 February 2028 | 28 February 2029 | Too early (27 February) | Accepted (other conditions met) |
| Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve, 24 months, established 31 August 2025 | 31 August 2027 | Too early | Accepted (other conditions met) |

A request meeting the date but signed by only one of two borrowers on the loan does not take effect; nor does one made while a repayment plan on the loan is active.
